name: Shem
bio:
Shem is Noah's eldest son, who became the ancestor of the line of Eber (the source of the word "Hebrew") and, ultimately, of the Israelite nation and Abraham's family line (Genesis 11:10-26). He entered the ark with his brothers Ham and Japheth and their father Noah, surviving the flood.

After the flood, Noah became drunk and lay uncovered in his tent; Ham saw him and told his two brothers, but Shem and Japheth took a garment, walked in backward, and covered their father without looking at his nakedness, showing him honor (Genesis 9:20-23). Noah blessed Shem for this, saying, "Blessed be the LORD God of Shem," and Shem's descendants were blessed as a result — a line that ultimately extends to Abraham, the nation of Israel, and the Messiah.
